read.thesis: Chubb's P&C ex-CAT combined ratio held at 81.8% with record investment income, but North America Commercial premiums fell 2.7% as management non-renewed underpriced property and financial lines and warned of "hungry and extremely naive capacity" in casualty.

triggers.label: NA property pricing down 4.2%
triggers.quote: Gross premium pricing in North America for commercial property was down 4.2%.

triggers.label: Alternative capital flooding casualty
triggers.quote: There is a lot of hungry and extremely naive capacity available.

triggers.label: Non-renewals of underpriced property and financial lines
triggers.quote: In the quarter, we again shed more property and financial lines exposure, which affected growth.

triggers.label: Shared/layered property pricing down 11%
triggers.quote: property pricing was down 11% in shared and layered major and specialty

guidance.metric: Core operating effective tax rate FY
guidance.quote: We continue to expect our core operating effective tax rate for the full year to be in the range of 19.5%-20%.

red_flags.label: Casualty pricing lagging loss cost
red_flags.quote: pricing in numerous areas is failing to keep pace with loss costs, which while steady, continue to well outpace general inflation.

red_flags.label: Management refuses to quantify NA Commercial glide path
red_flags.quote: Nice try, Tracy. I gave as much as I am going to give on that.

evasions.topic: NA Commercial glide path / underwriting finish line
evasions.quote: Nice try, Tracy. I gave as much as I am going to give on that.
I do not give guidance on margins.
